analysis.critical_caveat: ALL S6 runs have telemetry_exists=false — no candidate throughput data. CPU utilization alone does NOT indicate solver speed. High CPU may indicate redundant worker search, not faster solving. These results identify stable configs and resource envelopes only — NOT performance winners.
what_we_know: Binding workers can safely reduce to 2 — all configs with binding=2 ran successfully
No config crashed (unlike S5 matrix_1x16 which hit stack overrun)
RSS stays within 28-40 GiB for all tested configs
W6 private bytes (83 GiB) indicates heavy page file use — potential I/O bottleneck in longer runs
W7 (2 proc) has lowest RSS (28.55 GiB) — best memory efficiency
what_we_dont_know: Actual candidate throughput (candidates/hour) — 5-minute runs too short for campaign telemetry
Whether higher CPU utilization translates to faster candidate evaluation
